mechanism.claim: At a fixed eight-hour boundary in an unusually volatile BTC block, opposite final-two-hour ETH and BTC returns with a causally extreme absolute relative-return spread identify temporary cross-asset disagreement. Trade BTC in the ETH direction for six elapsed hours as crypto beta recouples.
mechanism.side: strict nonzero sign of final-two-hour ETHUSDT return, opposite the BTCUSDT return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVEDR requires opposite ETH/BTC directions and an extreme relative-return spread, then trades BTC toward ETH. HVELR required same-direction leadership and its direction_fade control retained that disjoint same-direction gate. Cross-venue disagreement candidates compared venues for BTC rather than distinct crypto assets. No prior control is promoted.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC cross-asset disagreement clocks and an ETH-minus-BTC spread tail gate are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 480 exact aligned distinct minute rows per symbol in [decision-8h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.late_returns: log(close at decision-1m/open at decision-2h) independently for ETH and BTC
features.direction_gate: ETH and BTC final-two-hour returns have opposite strict nonzero signs
features.relative_return_spread: ETH final-two-hour log return minus BTC final-two-hour log return
features.spread_tail_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute relative-return spread among at most 270 valid fixed blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.btc_realized_variation: sum squared BTC 1m close-to-close log returns within completed 8h block
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 270 valid fixed blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact BTC funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, source, or subset repair.
